content: iOS simulator test-host crash reports land as .ips files in host-level ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports/ (older in Retired/), with coalitionName com.apple.CoreSimulator.SimDevice.<UDID> correlating to the simulator; per-device CrashReporter dirs exist under ~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator/Devices/<UDID>/data/Library/Logs/CrashReporter/. GitHub actions/runner-images#12777 documents an xctest SIGBUS/exit-65 family on macOS-15 hosts faulting at class-realization (+[XCTestCase _allSubclasses] -> _EXHostConfiguration missing host symbol), a plausible lead for WINDOWS.md #8-style startup wedges.
